title: PROJECT_VISION.md
body:
Product: Gifscythe — a portable, click-and-use desktop app for animated images only (GIF, APNG, WebP). Version 0.1.0.

Mission: let a normal person edit, optimize, and convert animated images without ever seeing \a pile of code scrap." Audience is casual users plus power users who want full gifsicle terminal control underneath.

UX references: XnConvert feel/layout
sort_order: Caesium UI/UX files as a base (not a copy
column7: logo excluded).\n\nHard constraints: exclusively animated GIF/APNG/WebP; portable click-and-run
column9: no installer; retain gifsicle terminal-level control. APNG+WebP are bucket-list after the GIF UI/UX retrofit."
column10: The vision is sound. U-B3 (queue welded into one GIF) and U-B4 (empty output vaporizes the file, then says success) violate 'normal person, no surprises' directly. Windows-first is contradicted by POSIX-only CLI (NEW-12), Linux config.h on the Windows engine (NEW-1), and packagers that cannot copy gifsicle.exe (NEW-5). Fix the silent-failure class before any retrofit that claims to serve this vision.

title: WORKLIST.md
body:

Unchecked: Windows CI (failing), full GUI verification on Qt6/Windows, final GIF UI/UX retrofit and 1.0.0.

Next GIF tasks: (1) diagnose Windows CI, (2) Windows GUI + windeployqt, (3) Input/Actions/Output tabs, (4) drag-drop, queue controls, preview, progress, cancel, (5) remaining GifsicleSettings controls + raw command, (6) clean portable folder + release procedure, (7) bump 1.0.0 only after GIF UI is complete.

audit_take: Two checked boxes only partially hold: GUI MVP run-flow is broken (U-B3/B4/B5), packaging looks for the GUI where cmake never puts it (U-M6) and cannot copy gifsicle.exe (NEW-5). 'CLI driver and unit/integration tests' is checked — there is no integration test (U-MISS-6), and --run exits 0 on failure. Do not add task 3–7 chrome on top of silent false success. Re-open the CLI/tests and packaging boxes until CI artifacts prove them.

title: SESSION_HANDOFF.md
body:

Sandbox has no Qt6. Next work in order: fix Windows GHA + Windows Qt GUI; verify portable package on clean Windows; add tabs/drag-drop/preview/progress/queue; 1.0.0; only then WebP/APNG.

Linux 'passes' without an artifact proving a GUI was built and with cmake errors swallowed (U-B7, U-M5). Keep the version/scope constraints — they are the only claims that fully hold.

title: IMPROVEMENT_LOG.md
body: Newest first. 2026-09-06 GUI MVP: queue, optimize/lossy, output, command preview, status, process errors; packaging scripts; versioned release dir; SettingsIO parser tests; GHA (Linux green, Windows failing); WebP/APNG still deferred.\n\nEarlier same day: FEASIBILITY_REVIEW and the doc set; Caesium as UI base; reference_code vs working_code split; product named gifscythe v0.1.0; native gifsicle engine + test_engine.sh; control layer + CLI; optional-value flags attached (--lossy=N, -O3, -j4, --loopcount=0); Qt/Windows builds blocked in sandbox; authored diff compiles -Wall -Wextra -pedantic; scripts bash -n clean.
audit_take: Compile claims verify (this pass: CLI and 35/35 unit tests compile clean; engine 5/5). 'Unit + integration tests pass' does not — there is no integration test, and the CLI --run path is a false-green machine (U-B1). 'GUI built via Linux CI' is unproven: no artifact, qmake errors discarded. Treat the log as a diary, not as proof. Attach CI artifacts before checking a box here again.

title: FEASIBILITY_REVIEW.md
body:
Verdict: buildable as a new desktop app around gifsicle, not a tweak inside it. Recommended MVP is a subprocess wrapper (keeps GPL v2-only gifsicle out of a GPLv3/Caesium GUI). Live raw-CLI pane is the retain-terminal-control feature, specified as two-way.

Mapping table covers optimize, lossy, colors, dither methods, resize, scale, rotate, flip, crop, loop, delay, disposal, transparency, background, logical screen, colormap, comments, gamma, frame ops, mode, robustness.

License: gifsicle GPL v2-only; Caesium GPL v3; those cannot share a binary. Subprocess + shipping COPYING is the clean path. WebP/APNG need a common RGBA frame model later — gifsicle has zero WebP/APNG symbols.
audit_take: Architecture already matches the review (header-only core, subprocess engine, WebP deferred). Gaps are executional: unsafe exec (U-B6), unsynced pane (U-M3), no reverse parser (NEW-3). Two table errors the retrofit must not copy: delay listed as ms but -d is centiseconds (NEW-4); crop listed as X,Y,WxH but the engine wants X,Y+WxH and the code is already right (NEW-13). Do not implement S2's 'fix N1/N2/N14' — those would break correct flag mapping.
